_comment: Test cases to verify against real SQL Server instances via Docker. Each test has setup SQL (create objects), the SQL under test, and teardown SQL (cleanup).

tests.name: ALTER SERVICE MASTER KEY multi-option
tests.description: Comma-separated OLD_ACCOUNT/OLD_PASSWORD/NEW_ACCOUNT/NEW_PASSWORD. Our grammar + Microsoft docs say valid; both .NET parsers reject.
tests.sql: ALTER SERVICE MASTER KEY WITH OLD_ACCOUNT = 'OldAccount', OLD_PASSWORD = 'OldPwd', NEW_ACCOUNT = 'NewAccount', NEW_PASSWORD = 'NewPwd'

tests.name: DROP EXTERNAL TABLE IF EXISTS
tests.description: IF EXISTS on DROP EXTERNAL TABLE. All other DROP types support IF EXISTS. Both .NET parsers reject this.
tests.sql: DROP EXTERNAL TABLE IF EXISTS dbo.ExternalOrders

tests.name: CREATE TABLE PRIMARY KEY no cols
tests.description: PRIMARY KEY constraint with empty column list. Our parser rejects; SqlParser accepts.

tests.name: CREATE TABLE named PK no cols
tests.description: Named CONSTRAINT pk PRIMARY KEY with empty column list. Our parser rejects; SqlParser accepts.
tests.sql: CREATE TABLE #t_namedpk (CONSTRAINT pk PRIMARY KEY); DROP TABLE #t_namedpk;

tests.name: ALTER DATABASE NAME no value
tests.description: Filespec with bare NAME (no = 'value'). Our parser rejects; SqlParser accepts.

tests.name: CAST no AS
tests.description: CAST(expr) without AS type. Our parser rejects; SqlParser accepts.

tests.name: SELECT bare dollar sign
tests.description: SELECT $ — bare dollar. Our parser rejects; SqlParser treats as $0.00 money.

tests.name: OVER PARTITION no BY
tests.description: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION) — PARTITION without BY. Our parser rejects; ScriptDom 160+ accepts.
tests.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION) FROM (SELECT 1 AS x) t

tests.name: OVER ROWS no extent
tests.description: SUM(a) OVER (ROWS) — ROWS without frame bounds. Our parser rejects; ScriptDom 160+ accepts.
tests.setup: CREATE TABLE #t_rows (a INT); INSERT INTO #t_rows VALUES (1),(2),(3)

tests.name: COMPRESSION_DELAY MINUTE singular
tests.description: COMPRESSION_DELAY = 1 MINUTE (singular). Our grammar accepts; ScriptDom only accepts MINUTES (plural).
tests.sql: CREATE NONCLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX ncci ON #t_cd (a) WITH (COMPRESSION_DELAY = 1 MINUTE)

tests.name: COMPRESSION_DELAY MINUTES plural
tests.description: COMPRESSION_DELAY = 10 MINUTES (plural). Control test — should pass.
tests.sql: CREATE NONCLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX ncci ON #t_cdm (a) WITH (COMPRESSION_DELAY = 10 MINUTES)

tests.name: CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX with ORDER
tests.description: ORDER clause on clustered columnstore index. ScriptDom rejects at < 130.
tests.sql: CREATE CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX cci ON #t_cci WITH (ORDER(a))

tests.name: CREATE DATABASE FILEGROUP comma-separated
tests.description: FILEGROUP clause with comma separator (per SQL docs). Our grammar now requires comma.
tests.sql: CREATE DATABASE tsql_verify_fgdb ON PRIMARY (NAME = N'tsql_verify_fgdb', FILENAME = N'/var/opt/mssql/data/fgdb.mdf', SIZE = 8MB), FILEGROUP fg1 (NAME = N'fgdb_fg1', FILENAME = N'/var/opt/mssql/data/fgdb_fg1.ndf', SIZE = 8MB); DROP DATABASE tsql_verify_fgdb;

tests.name: CREATE DATABASE FILEGROUP no comma
tests.description: FILEGROUP clause without comma. Tests whether real SQL Server requires the comma.
tests.sql: CREATE DATABASE tsql_verify_fgdb2 ON PRIMARY (NAME = N'tsql_verify_fgdb2', FILENAME = N'/var/opt/mssql/data/fgdb2.mdf', SIZE = 8MB) FILEGROUP fg1 (NAME = N'fgdb2_fg1', FILENAME = N'/var/opt/mssql/data/fgdb2_fg1.ndf', SIZE = 8MB); DROP DATABASE tsql_verify_fgdb2;

tests.name: CREATE SYMMETRIC KEY comma before ENCRYPTION
tests.description: WITH ALGORITHM = AES_256, ENCRYPTION BY (comma). Tests if real SQL Server requires or rejects the comma.
tests.setup: CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'MK#Pass2024!'; CREATE CERTIFICATE TestCert WITH SUBJECT = 'Test'
tests.sql: CREATE SYMMETRIC KEY TestSymKey WITH ALGORITHM = AES_256, ENCRYPTION BY CERTIFICATE TestCert
tests.teardown: DROP SYMMETRIC KEY TestSymKey; DROP CERTIFICATE TestCert; DROP MASTER KEY

tests.name: CREATE SYMMETRIC KEY no comma before ENCRYPTION
tests.description: WITH ALGORITHM = AES_256 ENCRYPTION BY (no comma). Our current grammar; both .NET parsers accept.
tests.setup: CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'MK#Pass2024!'; CREATE CERTIFICATE TestCert2 WITH SUBJECT = 'Test'
tests.sql: CREATE SYMMETRIC KEY TestSymKey2 WITH ALGORITHM = AES_256 ENCRYPTION BY CERTIFICATE TestCert2
tests.teardown: DROP SYMMETRIC KEY TestSymKey2; DROP CERTIFICATE TestCert2; DROP MASTER KEY

tests.name: CREATE FULLTEXT CATALOG AS DEFAULT before AUTHORIZATION
tests.description: AS DEFAULT then AUTHORIZATION (our current order). Tests correct clause ordering.
tests.sql: CREATE FULLTEXT CATALOG tsql_verify_ftc AS DEFAULT AUTHORIZATION dbo; DROP FULLTEXT CATALOG tsql_verify_ftc;

tests.name: CREATE FULLTEXT CATALOG AUTHORIZATION before AS DEFAULT
tests.description: AUTHORIZATION then AS DEFAULT (our old order). Tests if reversed order works.
tests.sql: CREATE FULLTEXT CATALOG tsql_verify_ftc2 AUTHORIZATION dbo AS DEFAULT; DROP FULLTEXT CATALOG tsql_verify_ftc2;
